title: Retrieval Execution Result Contract
description: Normalised result emitted by the v0.5.0 execution engine. mode is always 'execute'. plan is the full v0.5.0 plan (strict execution-plan). repository_state is the multi-repo snapshot; its composite signature is scope_fingerprint. logical_adapter_calls is one call per adapter run over the multi-repo scope; it is bounded by call_budget (<=3). provider_process_invocations is the total number of provider processes spawned (one per repo per logical call); it is >= logical_adapter_calls and has no hard cap. fallback_count is the number of logical fallback calls; fallback_count <= logical_adapter_calls. progressive disclosure is stateless and limited to the same batch; focused_read_calls and focused_read_chars count the expansion. result_count = items.length, bounded by result_budget. raw_result_count is preserved separately. reason_codes is a $ref to the frozen catalogue. providers are restricted to ripgrep, git_grep, filesystem. Items carry repository_id, line, column, preview, preview_token, score, source_provider (null where appropriate).

provider.description: v0.5.0 executables: ripgrep, git_grep, filesystem. 'knowledge' is a strategy; the provider for it is 'filesystem'.

logical_adapter_calls.description: Number of logical adapter calls over the multi-repo scope. Includes the primary call and any fallback calls. Cache hits and pre-call availability probes do not count. Hard cap: 3.

call_budget.description: max_tool_calls from the executed plan. Invariant: logical_adapter_calls <= call_budget.

provider_process_invocations.description: Total provider processes spawned across all repos. One logical call over the multi-repo scope spawns one process per repo. No hard cap. Invariant: provider_process_invocations >= logical_adapter_calls.

fallback_count.description: Number of logical fallback calls. Invariant: fallback_count <= logical_adapter_calls.

raw_result_count.description: Items emitted by the adapter before dedup and budget. Independent from result_count.

char_count.description: emitted_chars — characters actually emitted (preview bytes) across items.

truncated.description: true if BUDGET_TRUNCATED or BUDGET_NORMALIZED was emitted.

cache_hits.description: Number of EQUIVALENT_REUSED events. Cache hits are only possible within the same batch (one process). Independent wrapper invocations do not share the cache.

deduped.description: Number of EQUIVALENT_DEDUPED items removed by the normalizer.

focused_read_calls.description: Number of focused reads (progressive disclosure expansions). Each focused read revalidates the scope_fingerprint, allowed roots, and deny globs. Always counted, never free.

focused_read_chars.description: Characters emitted across all focused reads.

first_relevant_result_ms.description: Milliseconds from start to first emitted item. null when no items were emitted.

adapter_stdout_chars.description: Total stdout characters produced by adapter invocations before normalisation.

normalized_chars.description: Characters after normaliser mapping, before budget truncation.

emitted_chars.description: Characters after budget truncation. Equals char_count.

estimated_tokens_emitted.description: Opaque estimate. Always null when emitted_chars == 0 and focused_read_chars == 0; otherwise > 0.

token_estimator_version.description: Versioned identifier of the deterministic estimator (e.g. 'token-estimator-v1'). Same version is used for baseline and result.

repository_id.description: Owning repository from the multi-repo scope.

preview_token.description: Continuation token. Set when PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE_APPLIED. Stateless: valid only within the same batch.

relations.description: Optional. Used by architecture / symbol kinds.
